extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from local XML/PDF/OA figures; automated placeholder mechanism notes removed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP38 treatment produced source-observed envelope damage in P. aeruginosa PA116136 and colistin-like outer-membrane blebs in S. marcescens; this is direct ultrastructural mechanism evidence, not a quantified permeability assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AMP38 against Gram-negative bacteria in this paper
mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM supports membrane/envelope morphology changes but does not by itself quantify carbapenem entry or define a molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The AMP38-carbapenem synergy is a phenotype-supported inference that AMP38 membrane disturbance can facilitate imipenem/meropenem access in OprD-defective P. aeruginosa strains.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AMP38 plus imipenem or meropenem in imipenem-resistant P. aeruginosa
mechanism_claims.limitations: Inference is supported by FICi/time-kill data and TEM context; no direct uptake assay is reported locally.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP38 plus imipenem has a source-reported antibiofilm phenotype against P. aeruginosa PA116136 biofilm, with a lower MBEC for the combination than either agent alone.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm eradication is an activity phenotype; the paper does not provide a separate biofilm-specific molecular mechanism assay.
